text:
olivia: FYI bringing up syd-edge GPU pool hit a weird failure on nodeboot, firmware handshake timed out and the node stayed in 'Provisioning - gpu-init' for >10m :grimacing:

samir: ugh, logs? any pattern (same SKU/AMI/driver)?

olivia: attaching excerpt from kubelet and kernel dmesg (shortened) -> see `GPU-FW-HS-TIMEOUT` and repeated NVLINK reinit attempts
```
[ 12:34:56 ] gpu-firmware: start handshake id=0x3f
[ 12:35:07 ] gpu-firmware: handshake timeout (12000ms) -> retry
[ 12:35:19 ] nvlink0: reinit attempt 1 failed
[ 12:36:07 ] node-agent: marking node unhealthy: provisioning-step=kernel-mods
[ 12:36:12 ] deploy-bot: rollback triggered for pool/syd-edge/ami-2026-03
```

marta: which firmware bundle are we pushing? IIRC last bundle had new SMU bits that were flaky on older H100 revs. Might be a mismatch between vendor fw and our patched AMI kernel modules.

ryan: confirmed affected SKU = h100p-48gb-revA (older steppings). We saw a similar failure in canary last week but we auto-snoozed it.

olivia: canary had 2/12 nodes flaky, we escalated but didn't pause rollout. this time ~30% of the nodes in the pool failed -> autoscaler kept retrying and deploy-bot rolled the whole AMI back. now some nodes are in a boot loop.

samir: immediate mitigation ideas:
- pause further AMI rollouts
- mark revA SKUs as "avoid" in the placement policy
- run targeted repro on one affected host with serial console access
- if handshake fails, try forcing firmware rollback to previous bundle via vendor tool

jenna: noted. I'm oncall and can coordinate serial access + vendor ticket. tagging @marta for vendor escalation.

marta: vendor says the firmware handshake timeout occurs when kernel module loads concurrently with vendor fw service during init. workaround is to delay module probe for 10s or pre-flash nodes.

olivia: we do have a module probe delay config in our node boot scripts but the new vendor service started earlier in the AMI due to systemd ordering change. that explains why older revs are impacted more (timing windows).

samir: ok concrete runbook I'm going to start executing now:
1) Disable automatic AMI rollout to other regions: `infractl pools pause-rollout --pool syd-edge`
2) Add temporary placement tag to avoid revA: `infractl nodepolicies set-avoid --sku h100p-48gb-revA --scope syd-edge`
3) Reimage a single failed host with previous AMI and run vendor flash script: `sudo vendor-fwctl --rollback --bundle v2026-02 && reboot`
4) If successful, create a hotfix AMI adjusting systemd ordering (delay vendor-fw.service or add ExecStartPre sleep 12) and roll to canary 1 node
5) Monitor `gpu-firmware` logs and NVLINK states for 30m, then resume gradual rollout

deploy-bot: rollback completed for ami-2026-03 -> ami-2026-02 (automated).

olivia: I started step 3 on node syd-gpu-13, serial shows rollback success but kernel mods still failing once then ok after reboot. copying logs to the incident doc.

ryan: cost note: we consumed extra spot capacity while autoscaler retried (~120 GPU-minutes wasted). ops wants a short retro on gating firmware rollouts to prevent fleet-wide churn; might need a preflight bench that runs firmware init on 3 sku variants before full rollout.

marta: agreed. long-term: add a firmware-init preflight in our image pipeline that runs vendor-fwctl + module probe cycle under serial console emulation for all supported steppings. Short-term: hotfix AMI + placement avoid + gated canary.

jenna: opening incident ticket: INC-2026-058, will include timeline + node list + vendor case id. handing off to oncall rotation for follow-ups.

olivia: thanks team. I'll keep this thread updated with canary results. current status: paused rollout, avoidance policy applied, one node repro successful, vendor engaged.

samir: when can we resume? put ETA as 'after 1h stable canary + vendor ack'

marta: vendor suggests also bumping fw handshake timeout to 20s as emergency knob, but prefer systemd ordering fix. I'll draft PR for AMI change.

olivia: PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/ami-images/pulls/412 - includes ExecStartPre sleep and systemd ordering change. planning canary in 15m.

infra-bot: monitoring alert created -> alert_id=A-3442, recipients=eng-infra,oncall.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary reimage -> pool=syd-edge node=syd-gpu-21 window=now+15m.

ryan: also add a billing note for finance: tag wasted spot time with cost-center=infra-emergency so we can track immediate impact.

jenna: got it, tagging cost center. handing off to morning shift to verify vendor follow-up.

olivia: last update before handoff: canary node came up healthy after AMI hotfix, nvlink stable, no further handshake timeouts in 25m. leaving rollout paused until vendor confirms full bundle compatibility.

samir: great, will write a short postmortem and add rehearsal to the bring-up runbook to run firmware-init on revA, revB, revC.

marta: thanks everyone. end of thread for now. :thumbsup:
